summary: The new pay schedule at {workplace} gives workers increases beyond management's offer to their negotiators.
realLife: After the union rejected a proposed wage schedule in Katz, the employer announced a more generous automatic raise system without consulting it.
gates: The case record identifies the last bargaining offer and announced pay schedule.
inGame: needs: last bargaining offer and announced pay schedule.

turns.what: Negotiators identify who gains sooner under the posted scale.
The representative checks notice and bargaining history before describing the change.
